definitions.explanation: Organized extracurricular activities at schools, typically sports teams, cultural clubs, or academic groups. A defining feature of Japanese school life from middle school through university.

examples.japanese: {部活動|ぶかつどう}は{何|なに}をしていますか。
examples.english: What club activities do you participate in?

examples.japanese: {放課後|ほうかご}は{毎日|まいにち}{部活動|ぶかつどう}がある。
examples.english: There are club activities every day after school.

examples.japanese: {中学校|ちゅうがっこう}では{部活動|ぶかつどう}への{参加|さんか}がほぼ{必須|ひっす}とされている。
examples.english: In middle school, participation in club activities is practically required.

notes:
Often shortened to {部活|ぶかつ} in everyday speech. This is one of the most distinctive aspects of Japanese school culture, with students expected to commit seriously to a single club throughout the school year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部活動|ぶかつどう}に{入|はい}る (to join a club)
- {部活動|ぶかつどう}を{辞|や}める (to quit a club)
- {部活動|ぶかつどう}に{励|はげ}む (to devote oneself to club activities)

USAGE:
{部活動|ぶかつどう} is the formal term used in school documents and by teachers. Students almost always say {部活|ぶかつ} in conversation.
